사도행전 6:1.content: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

사도행전 6:2.content: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

사도행전 6:3.content: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

사도행전 6:4.content: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

사도행전 6:5.content: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

사도행전 6:6.content: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

사도행전 6:7.content: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

사도행전 6:8.content: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

사도행전 6:9.content: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

사도행전 6:10.content: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.

사도행전 6:11.content: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.

사도행전 6:12.content: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,

사도행전 6:13.content: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

사도행전 6:14.content: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.

사도행전 6:15.content: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
